rationale: The complete goal is the entry acquisition of entities, relations, cardinalities and optionalities. None of its contains ancestors adds a requirement.
A passed whole Q1 assessment additionally demands OO implementations, sorting, recursion, data structures and graph algorithms. These are not necessary to start or demonstrate this ER competence.
Keep only the already authored shared orientation entry. Its German description explicitly requires no technical detail knowledge; this is course entry, not a replacement broad competence exam.

Do not substitute the whole general model-reflection goal: choosing among modelling procedures and judging model decisions is broader than applying an explicitly supplied ER method to a small world. A learner need not first master that complete cross-model metacompetence.

OO class abstraction is a possible teaching bridge, but not a necessary unique route to ER concepts, and its current prerequisite would import another whole exam. No new mandatory OO path is justified here.

concreteReviewCounterexample.context: Ein Mitglied kann momentan null oder mehrere Exemplare ausleihen. Jedes Exemplar ist momentan an höchstens ein Mitglied ausgeliehen.
concreteReviewCounterexample.requiredPerformance: Mitglied und Exemplar als Entitätstypen, ausleihen als Beziehung sowie 0..* beziehungsweise 0..1 als Kardinalität und Optionalität korrekt darstellen und am Sachtext begründen.
concreteReviewCounterexample.whyOldGateIsNotNecessary: This complete ER performance can be learned and demonstrated without programming inheritance, implementing sorting/recursion or executing graph algorithms. ER notation and cardinality interpretation are the content of this goal, not prior completion of all Q1.

rationale: The complete goal concerns modelling and simulation of automata from real contexts; its parent specifies finite acceptors/transducers. It does not demand implementing a simulator or an object-oriented program. None of its contains ancestors adds a prerequisite.
The whole Q2 assessment adds ER normalization/cardinalities, SQL aggregation, web/database integration and further topics. These are not necessary for a finite-state real-world model.
Keep only the existing shared orientation entry. Do not use the general model-reflection goal as a mandatory complete metacompetence before a first specified finite-state model.

Reject 2aaefe0b as a required replacement: its complete description explicitly demands assignments during implementation and attribute-state changes. A transition table or paper simulation need not execute any program assignment.
Do not use DFA/NFA conversion, minimization or later regular-language goals as foundations: their present prerequisite paths already depend on the elementary automaton goal.

The separately reviewed complex-state-diagram goal can require this elementary goal after this Q2-exam bridge is removed; leaving the bridge while adding that later dependency would create a cycle through the Q2 assessment.

concreteReviewCounterexample.context: Drehkreuz mit Zuständen gesperrt/offen, Start gesperrt, Eingaben Münze/Drücken.
concreteReviewCounterexample.requiredPerformance: Den endlichen Zustandsspeicher, die Übergänge und Ausgaben aus dem realen Kontext modellieren sowie die angegebene Eingabefolge korrekt simulieren.
concreteReviewCounterexample.whyOldOrAlternativeGateIsNotNecessary: This complete model/simulation requires neither an ER/SQL/web assessment pass nor implementing assignments into object attributes.

rationale: The application goal explicitly names DFS. Its current predecessor bundles DFS, BFS and shortest paths using BFS. Full BFS/shortest-path mastery does not follow from DFS cycle/bridge performance and is not established as a necessary preparation gate by these texts.

The complete canonical title/description search found no separately assessable DFS-only foundation. The existing graph-representation goal is useful preparation but does not supply the DFS traversal, discovery/back-edge or bridge reasoning that this application needs. Replacing the predecessor with representation alone would silently drop that prerequisite rather than repair the bundle.

Therefore this package neither removes the bundled edge nor approves its whole bundle as didactically necessary. It needs a separately reviewed goal/content decomposition or a documented acquisition route before a narrower exact array can be justified. No new goal or changed coverage is proposed here.
